title: data for billing.invoice_created
description: An invoice was issued: the monthly fee of a cycle (issued before the renewal), prorated seats added mid-cycle or the overage of a closed cycle. Pay it through checkout_url (payment link) or, with consent, with the preserved paid balance. Envelope business_id and channel_id are null.

kind.description: subscription = monthly fee of the cycle; seat_addition = prorated seats added mid-cycle; overage = messages above the allowance (only with a published price and the integrator's authorization).

total_micros.description: Invoice total (multiple of 10000: whole cents). Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").

checkout_url.description: Payment link (Pix or card); null when the invoice is paid with the preserved balance or the link is not generated yet.
